name: WCS Store Rules – Minimum and Maximum Purchase Rules for Products, Orders, Categories, User Roles and Location
author: WC Studio

sections.description:
WCS Store Rules is the ultimate WooCommerce plugin designed to give store owners full control over their store’s pricing, visibility, purchasing restrictions, and user-based rules. Whether you want to set up dynamic pricing, restrict purchases by user roles, limit product visibility, or enforce cart conditions, Store Rules offers a seamless and flexible solution.

Transform your WooCommerce store with powerful rule-based functionalities without compromising user experience or performance.

🎯This Plugin Is Ideal for:

  • Wholesale & B2B Stores
  • Membership-Based Shops
  • Subscription or Digital Product Sellers
  • Country or Region-Specific Retailers
  • Age or Legally Restricted Product Sellers
  • Seasonal/Event-Driven Sales Campaigns

🎯 Rule Application Hierarchy

Store Rules apply purchase conditions in the following priority order:
1️⃣ General → 2️⃣ Category → 3️⃣ Role → 4️⃣ Schedule → 5️⃣ Product Meta

Each level can override the previous one, allowing for fine-tuned purchase control.

🛠 Modules Overview

1️⃣ General Rules (Global Store-Wide Rules)

✔ Applies store-wide purchase conditions as the base rule.
✔ Can be overridden by more specific rule types.

2️⃣ Category-Based Rules

✔ Set custom purchase rules per product category.
✔ Apply discounts, restrictions, or exclusive offers for selected categories.
✔ Perfect for seasonal sales, VIP pricing, or bulk category-based purchases rules.

3️⃣ Role-Based Rules

✔ Assign purchase conditions based on user roles (Admin, Customer, Wholesale, Guest).
✔ Differentiate pricing strategies for retail, wholesale, and VIP customers.
✔ Ideal for B2B WooCommerce stores.

4️⃣ Schedule-Based Rules

✔ Automate purchase rules for time-sensitive promotions (flash sales, holiday offers, etc.).
✔ Set start and end dates for limited-time discounts.
✔ Enable or disable products at scheduled times.

5️⃣ Product Meta-Based Rules

✔ Apply purchase conditions based on SKUs, product tags, or metadata.
✔ Target specific products using WooCommerce custom fields.
✔ Great for exclusive promotions, restricted items, or custom product pricing.

6️⃣ Cart-Based Rules (Independent Feature)

✔ Works separately from other modules.
✔ Apply purchase restrictions based on cart value, quantity, or total items.
✔ Useful for bulk purchase limits, free shipping thresholds, and cart-based pricing rules.

7️⃣ Area-Based Rules (Checkout-Based Feature)

✔ Implement location-based purchase rules.
✔ Restrict or allow purchases based on shipping zones, billing addresses, or country-based conditions.
✔ Perfect for geo-restricted pricing and international selling policies.

Why Choose Store Rules?

✅ Comprehensive Purchase Rule Management
✅ Seamless WooCommerce Integration
✅ Time-Based & Location-Based Rules
✅ Flexible Customization for Any Store

✨ Business Benefits of Using Store Rules

Better Store Management
Streamline operations with automated restrictions and rule-based customizations.

Enhanced User Experience
Show relevant products to the right users without cluttering their shopping experience.

Optimized Checkout Process
Prevent unwanted purchases and enforce essential store policies without manual intervention.

Improved Conversion Rates
Encourage bulk purchases and upselling by implementing targeted pricing and cart rules.

Seamless Integration With WooCommerce
Works with existing WooCommerce features and plugins without conflicts.

⚡ More Upcoming Features

We’re constantly improving Store Rules with powerful new features. Here’s what’s coming next:

  • Pre-built Rule Templates
  • Product Bundle Rules
  • AI-Powered Rule Suggestions
  • Advanced Analytics Dashboard
  • Role-Based Coupons & Vouchers
  • Auto Rule Triggers Based on Activity
sections.installation:
1. Download & Install

    • Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/store-rules directory.
    • Or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen.

  2. Activate the Plugin

    • Go to the Plugins menu and activate Store Rules.

  3. Configure Settings

    • Navigate to Store Rules and configure the purchase conditions as per your store’s needs.
sections.faq:
1️⃣ Can I apply rules for different user roles?

Yes! You can customize visibility, pricing, and restrictions for any user role.

2️⃣ Can I restrict access by location?

Absolutely! Geo-based rules allow product/category visibility by country or region.

3️⃣ Can I set purchase limits?

Yes, you can define minimum/maximum limits for products, categories, or carts.

4️⃣ Is it compatible with other discount plugins?

Yes, Store Rules works seamlessly with most WooCommerce pricing plugins.

5️⃣ Can I schedule rules for sales/events?

Definitely! Time-based rules let you automate restrictions for campaigns or holidays.
